Hi Raj / Sara,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — appreciate you walking us through the clinical ingestion flow and the regulatory constraints. Below is a compact summary of what we heard, the business goals you called out, and concrete next steps so we all have the same checkpoints for the POC.

Summary of pain points / constraints
- Data residency: All patient data must remain in the US West region; any backups must be stored on customer-managed buckets.
- Air-gap / isolation: Security team prefers an outbound-only, forced-proxy model with no inbound public endpoints to the inference cluster.
- Audit & compliance: SOC 2 evidence and access logs will be required before pilot sign-off; retention policy is 7 years for selected logs.
- Network constraints: Medivault sits behind a corporate firewall with strict egress IP whitelisting; express-route / private peering is preferred over public VPN for throughput predictability.
- Latency requirement: Integration with EHR must have predictable tail latency — target P95 < 200ms for the inference call from your app to our gateway.

Business goals & success criteria
- Short POC (6 weeks) to validate: (1) secure connectivity + integration with Medivault staging EHR, (2) throughput at expected concurrency (50 concurrent sessions), (3) no data leaving region or being logged into a shared bucket.
- Post-POC decision: move to a 12–18 month Dedicated/Private deployment if the above are met.

Immediate technical asks / owner assignments
1) Network checklist: Ben to share a trimmed checklist with firewall rules, required ports, and preferred peer ranges (attached). ACTION: Medivault to confirm egress IP allowlist.
2) Sample data: Medivault to provide a small, de-identified sample schema (CSV) for parsing tests. ACTION: Sara to upload sample by next Wed 5/5.
3) Deep dive: Schedule a technical architecture call with Medivault infra and security to walk the air-gap pattern and KMS integration. Propose Wed 5/6 or Thu 5/7; Ben + I will join.
4) Compliance artifacts: I will send a SOC 2 evidence checklist and our standard DPA template; Marissa (legal) will be looped for redlines.

Next steps & timeline (proposed)
- 4/30: Ben shares finalized network checklist.
- 5/5: Medivault uploads sample dataset and confirms allowlist.
- 5/6 or 5/7: Technical deep dive with infra + security.
- 5/14: Begin test POC (two-week ramp + validation).

If anything above reads differently than how you remember the call, flag it and I’ll correct. Otherwise I’ll schedule the tech call for 5/6 10:00am PT and Ben will circulate the checklist.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.
